title: KJI首席：中国AI发展确定性更高，互联网巨头将成最终赢家
speaker: Cousin Lender

segments.en: So, you can argue that the visibility and the certainty of the China AI development model is actually much higher.
segments.zh: 可以说，中国AI发展模式的可见性和确定性实际上更高。

segments.en: And just because of the short term market and the performance, I don't think the Chinese will be changing this business model.
segments.zh: 仅仅因为短期市场和表现，我认为中国不会改变这种商业模式。

segments.en: So, in terms of the beneficiaries then, I mean, you said you still favor some of these downstream AI names. Right now, what are going to be those potential winners?
segments.zh: 那么关于受益者，您说您仍然看好一些下游AI公司。现在哪些会是潜在赢家？

segments.en: No, I think we're similar to the last boom of the internet bubble, who developed internet. Some may know, some forget, but the company is not there, who make most of the money from internet.
segments.zh: 我认为类似上一次互联网泡沫，那些开发互联网的公司，有些知名有些已被遗忘，但真正从互联网赚到最多钱的不是它们。

segments.en: Those who use the best use of internet make the most money out of that.
segments.zh: 那些最好地利用互联网的公司赚到了最多的钱。

segments.en: I think similar in China, a lot of big internet giants, they have a huge ecosystem and they are incorporating the AI model into the existing business. That will prove them to be the ultimate winner in this AI race.
segments.zh: 类似地，中国很多大型互联网巨头拥有庞大生态系统，正在将AI模型融入现有业务。这将证明它们是这场AI竞赛的最终赢家。
